verdict.rationale: HeyGen's developer docs say every endpoint ships with "typed schemas" alongside llms.txt and an MCP server, which suggests some machine-readable endpoint definitions. However, no downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec file is documented, and probes of the standard OpenAPI/Swagger paths all returned 404. The llms.txt file (HTTP 200) is a prose documentation index, not an API spec. Missing for 10: a documented, downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger (or equivalent) spec file with a known URL, details on what format the "typed schemas" take and how to retrieve them, and independent or hands-on confirmation that a spec can be fetched.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Every endpoint ships with an MCP server, llms.txt, and typed schemas
